labels: enhancement

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? Is your feature request related to a problem?
Example: "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Example Usage
If applicable, show how you envision using this feature:

```python
# Example code showing the proposed API
```

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Implementation Language
Which language implementation(s) should this apply to?
- [ ] Python
- [ ] Flutter/Dart
- [ ] Rust
- [ ] All languages
- [ ] New language implementation

## Benefits
Why would this feature be useful to others? Who would benefit from it?

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, references, or links about the feature request here.

## References
- Link to relevant papers, documentation, or examples
- Related issues or pull requests
